en.headline: Hong Kong Open badminton moves to Kai Tak Arena for first time next week
en.dek: The BWF Super 500 tournament runs from 17 to 22 November at the new venue with local players in the draws and tickets from HK$70.
body: The LI-NING Hong Kong Open Badminton Championships 2026, part of the HSBC BWF World Tour Super 500, will be held for the first time at Kai Tak Arena from 17 to 22 November.

The Badminton Association of Hong Kong, China said the move from the Hong Kong Coliseum marks a milestone. The arena offers larger capacity. The event has a prize purse of US$500,000 and has attracted entries from more than 20 countries and regions. Local players including Ng Ka Long, Lee Cheuk Yiu and others are in the draws.

Single-session tickets are priced from HK$70 to HK$980 depending on the day and session. They are available through HK Ticketing and Damai. The association has also secured Super 750 status for future editions from 2027 to 2030.
The tournament is an M Mark event recognised by the Major Sports Events Committee.

zh.headline: 香港羽毛球公開賽下周首度移師啟德體藝館
zh.dek: 世界羽聯超級500賽事11月17至22日於啟德舉行，本地球員出戰，門票由70元起。
body: 李寧香港羽毛球公開賽2026（滙豐世界羽聯世界巡迴賽超級500）將於11月17日至22日首度在啟德體藝館舉行。
中國香港羽毛球總會表示，賽事由紅磡香港體育館移師啟德，屬重要里程碑。新場館可容納更多觀眾。賽事獎金總額為50萬美元，吸引逾20個國家及地區選手參賽。本地球員包括伍家朗、李卓耀等均有出戰。
單場門票售價由70元至980元不等，視乎日子及場次，現於快達票及大麥網發售。總會已取得2027至2030年超級750賽事主辦權。
是項賽事獲大型體育活動事務委員會評為M Mark活動。
